about.body: The AJ150 is Jaguar Land Rover's 1.5-litre three-cylinder petrol engine from the Ingenium family, in production since 2017. It was introduced as the smallest displacement option in the Ingenium range, designed primarily for the E-Pace compact SUV where it serves as the entry-level petrol powertrain.

byModel.body: The AJ150 appears in a single application within the Jaguar range — the E-Pace (X540, 2017–present), specifically in the P200 and P250 variants. This three-cylinder engine was developed as part of the modular Ingenium strategy, sharing its fundamental architecture with the larger AJ200 and AJ200P four-cylinder engines. While the AJ150 is also used in some Land Rover applications, our work here covers Jaguar-badged vehicles exclusively.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ150 sits within the same Ingenium family as the larger four-cylinder engines, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model and generation. The same base engine code spans multiple output variants — P200 and P250 — with different ECU calibrations and ancillaries depending on the specific application.
